async def act(page):
    # Step 1: Fill in the issue title with the specified question
    title_field = page.get_by_role('textbox', name='Title (required)', exact=True)
    await title_field.fill('Plan to support Webagent in huggingface dataset next quarter?')
    
    # Step 2: Fill in the issue description with the specified content
    description_field = page.get_by_role('textbox', name='Description', exact=True)
    await description_field.fill('Do you have any plan on supporting Webagent in the next quarter in huggingface dataset?')
    
    # Step 3: Find and click the submit button to create the issue
    # Use a case-insensitive substring match for the button name, as the exact label might vary
    submit_button = page.get_by_role('button', name='issue', exact=False)
    await submit_button.click()
    
    # Step 4: Wait for the page to load after submission to ensure the issue is created
    await page.wait_for_load_state('networkidle')
    # No further actions needed; the issue creation is complete
